extra_quotes: The dataset contains 70 independently generated phase-field trajectories on a uniform 512×768 grid.

For the wall-clock comparison, the phase-field solver was timed on 12 CPU nodes of CSC’s Mahti supercomputer using 1,536 MPI ranks, corresponding to one rank per physical core. Surrogate inference was measured at batch size one on a single AMD MI250X Graphics Compute Die (GCD) of LUMI [27, 28]. Timings compare advancement over the same 750-step interval.

Because stochastic perturbations can shift individual branches over long horizons, these physical quantities are interpreted together with qualitative spatial comparisons rather than exact pixel-wise similarity.
Future work should evaluate the model across a broader range of thermal histories and processing conditions relevant to additive manufacturing.
